status: Prospective preparation only; native execution, timing and publication require the separate source/tooling review
scope: Six fixed synthetic enclosing-component failure-overhead cells; separate from dictionary cells and complete-browser import qualification

source.compilation: Pinned Clang/LLD21.1.8; unchanged baseline reproduces tracked artifact; exact candidate C/patch/WASM/manifest and diagnostic binary bound by common preflight

input.grouping: One fused two-bank group; no reset at bank2
input.legacyCases: Cases1..3 require byte-identical original raw/compressed banks and CRCs; they are inactive prior-streak controls
input.activeCases: Case4 XXY242B; case5 L4096B,S18B,S18B,L-prime4096B; case6 Q242B,H242B,S18B,S18B,Q242B; block identity never resets at bank boundary
input.compression: deflateRawSync level6 under exact Node22.22.0/zlib; generation/compression/hash/independent state replay before acquisition
input.rawByteGeometry: Exact lengths, identity offsets and late mutation/sample offsets in fixtureGeometry; all include JSON delimiters

acquisition.schedule: Pairs0,2 ABCD; pairs1,3 DCBA; A,C,D baseline and B candidate
acquisition.pairedUnit: The fixed16-pass sum from one fresh child; repetitions are not independent observations
acquisition.scopePerPass: Fresh native compressed inflate/CRC, strict parse, content encoding and completed lookup construction; exact original execute clock block
acquisition.digest: Full canonical/key/numeric/index/dedup-plan/media digest after each clock interval and before WASM-backed views are reused
acquisition.excludedPreflightsPerCase: One baseline verify-only child plus one exact candidate instrumented mechanics child, one pass each; all displayed durations excluded
acquisition.activationGate: All48 exact diagnostic fields, exact public recent/unique counts and full digest must agree before the case timing; active failures must exercise the selected full proof exactly
acquisition.serialIsolation: No concurrent experiment commands in this job; external host contention is uncontrolled and assessed with same-code controls. Root owns one serial nine-cell schedule: JMdict, negatives1..6, Jitendex, VNDB.
acquisition.failurePolicy: No retry, resumption or selective replacement; retain all raw logs, completed pass receipts, status and partial plans. A failed cell remains failed; independent later cells may run only after global source/correctness/input gates passed.

rejection.controlCriterion: Candidate median slowdown must exceed the largest absolute same-case C/D paired change
rejection.actionIfTriggered: Hold/reject the exact candidate; no adaptive admission/cap/budget retuning within the cohort
rejection.ambiguousResult: Hold/qualification limitation; failure to trigger the rule is not proof of equivalence

limits: One hosted runner is a fail-fast component screen, not complete-import, browser-memory, or equivalence qualification
Full-comparison bytes are offered proof lengths, not observed instruction-level bytes read
These fixed prefix patterns are not exhaustive; case6 protects first-prefix-only semantics while still producing downstream complete-content hits
No pooling with original-prefix hosted/local evidence or numeric-suffix studies
